lean.statement:
∀ (m : ℝ), ∃ γ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ),
      Transport.IsCoupling γ
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal (-m) 1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal m 1)
        ((1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal (-m) 1 + (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal m 1) ∧
      (∫⁻ z, WassersteinSpace.quadraticCost z ∂γ) = ENNReal.ofReal (m ^ 2)
approved_definition_context: gaussianReal a v is the actual real Gaussian probability measure of mean a and variance v.
Transport.IsCoupling holds exactly when the first and second pushforward marginals of the product measure equal the respective supplied measures.
WassersteinSpace.quadraticCost of the pair (x,y) is the extended nonnegative value ENNReal.ofReal (‖x−y‖²). The lintegral is the nonnegative measure integral.
Scaling a measure by a finite nonnegative scalar scales its mass and integrals; sums are sums of measures.
